title: Read a typed body
summary: ASP.NET Web API: Read a typed body. Post a different title.
introduction: FromBody reads a JSON request body. Send POST /books with application/json and {"title":"Moon Trip"}.
learningObjectives: Read a typed body with ASP.NET Web API

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n SchoolApi and enter it. Replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. These examples use controllers without a database.

blocks.title: Read a typed body

blocks.text: The JSON title is bound to the record. Ok returns that typed value as JSON.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Send the correct Content-Type so JSON can be parsed.
